name: Tailraise
summary:
A transformation-focused RPG full of exploration, kink, and adventure.

Tailraise is a narrative RPG set in Itum, a high-tech nation rebuilt by a magical transformation resource known as essence. For the first time in centuries, outsiders like you are being welcomed in.

You play as a newcomer to a world full of magic and mystery, trying to understand who you are in a world where changing yourself is the norm. Explore strange towns, flirt with locals, and uncover the tangled past of a nation still struggling to define what makes someone truly themselves.

You'll explore towns, build relationships, uncover secrets, and reshape your body and story.
